sets.title: Puzzle 21: Ranking of 4 people by wealth
sets.text:
4 people (Madhavi, Hema, Nandini, Sneha) have different wealths. Conditions:
1. Sneha is richer than Nandini, and nobody is between them in wealth.
2. Sneha and Hema are next to each other when the 4 are arranged by wealth.
3. Madhavi is richer than Nandini.

sets.title: Puzzle 22: Ranking of 4 people by height
sets.text:
4 people (Yamini, Hema, Charan, Prakash) have different heights. Conditions:
1. Charan and Yamini are next to each other when the 4 are arranged by height.
2. Yamini is taller than Prakash, and nobody is between them in height.
3. Hema is not the shortest.

sets.title: Puzzle 23: Ranking of 4 people by weight
sets.text:
4 people (Omkar, Venkat, Pooja, Ishita) have different weights. Conditions:
1. Pooja is heavier than Omkar, and nobody is between them in weight.
2. Ishita is heavier than Pooja.
3. Venkat is heavier than Ishita.

sets.title: Puzzle 24: Ranking of 5 people by age
sets.text:
5 people (Karthik, Ramesh, Mohan, Venkat, Suresh) have different ages. Conditions:
1. Exactly 2 people are between Ramesh and Karthik in age.
2. Suresh is older than Karthik, and nobody is between them in age.
3. Karthik and Venkat are next to each other when the 5 are arranged by age.
4. Mohan is older than Ramesh, and nobody is between them in age.

sets.title: Puzzle 25: Ranking of 5 people by wealth
sets.text:
5 people (Imran, Pooja, Balaji, Rohit, Naveen) have different wealths. Conditions:
1. Balaji is richer than Imran.
2. Exactly 3 people are poorer than Pooja.
3. Pooja is richer than Naveen.
4. Exactly 2 people are between Naveen and Rohit in wealth.

sets.title: Puzzle 26: Ranking of 5 people by weight
sets.text:
5 people (Karthik, Bharat, Gopal, Kavya, Vikram) have different weights. Conditions:
1. Exactly 2 people are between Kavya and Vikram in weight.
2. Bharat and Karthik are next to each other when the 5 are arranged by weight.
3. Vikram is lighter than Bharat.
4. Exactly 1 person is lighter than Karthik.

sets.title: Puzzle 27: Ranking of 5 people by weight
sets.text:
5 people (Divya, Charan, Ramesh, Gayathri, Balaji) have different weights. Conditions:
1. Gayathri is not the lightest.
2. Gayathri is lighter than Divya.
3. Balaji is heavier than Divya, and nobody is between them in weight.
4. Divya is heavier than Ramesh, and nobody is between them in weight.

sets.title: Puzzle 28: Ranking of 5 people by weight
sets.text:
5 people (Saravanan, Arjun, Chitra, Charan, Uma) have different weights. Conditions:
1. Charan is heavier than Saravanan, and nobody is between them in weight.
2. Arjun and Chitra are next to each other when the 5 are arranged by weight.
3. Saravanan and Uma are next to each other when the 5 are arranged by weight.
4. Chitra is lighter than Uma.
5. Chitra is lighter than Arjun.

sets.title: Puzzle 29: Ranking of 6 people by age
sets.text:
6 people (Divya, Charan, Yamini, Deepa, Manoj, Chitra) have different ages. Conditions:
1. Yamini and Divya are next to each other when the 6 are arranged by age.
2. Manoj is older than Charan, and nobody is between them in age.
3. Deepa and Manoj are next to each other when the 6 are arranged by age.
4. Exactly 2 people are younger than Divya.

sets.title: Puzzle 30: Ranking of 6 people by wealth
sets.text:
6 people (Jagan, Pooja, Saravanan, Kavya, Vikram, Latha) have different wealths. Conditions:
1. Kavya is poorer than Jagan.
2. Vikram is poorer than Pooja.
3. Exactly 1 person is between Kavya and Latha in wealth.
4. Vikram is not the poorest.
5. Exactly 3 people are poorer than Jagan.
6. Saravanan and Vikram are next to each other when the 6 are arranged by wealth.
